| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Codes as an image | Codes as an image, Histogram table | The code of every pixel as a gray image, or a table with how often each code occurs. With the variance method, the output is always an image. |
| **Points** `points` | 8 | 4 to 24 | The number P of sample points on the circle. Each gives one bit. |
| **Radius** `radius` | 1 | 1 to 8 px | The radius R of the circle of sample points. |
| **Method** `method` | Default (all codes) | Default (all codes), Rotation invariant, Uniform, rotation invariant, Uniform, not rotation invariant, Variance | How the bits become a code. The names are those of scikit-image. |
